verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents creating a card through the Core API and issuing instant virtual cards ready for immediate use, and offers a public sandbox to build in. Card creation requires creating a user and card product first, so it is not a single call. Sandbox cards cannot transact in the real world, and nothing documents a self-serve path to live. Missing for 10: single-call issuance, documented programmatic return of PAN/CVV/expiry at issuance, evidence of going from sandbox to production without a sales cycle, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a virtual card through the API in one call — PAN, CVV, and expiry available programmatically the moment it's issued — and go from sandbox to a live card without a sales cycle

citations.quote: You create a card using the `user_token` of the user who will own the card and the `card_product_token`
Virtual card issuance: Create instant-issue virtual cards that are ready for immediate use.
Public sandbox: A single-user environment where you can begin building your program.
